purpose: Why the built-in voice of Drama 3 ran to the 1024-frame cap or stopped short of the text, and the fix: eos kept in every nucleus, a serve-side default silence guard, and a redraw of a take the guard silenced. Per-frame evidence in trace-20261121/, protocol arms below.

engine.build: trim-bf16-int3 (14.50 GiB), Mac NVFP4 engine, scripts/build-engine.sh --weights nvfp4

protocol: smaller-builds: 24 texts, salts 0/1, built-in and eq-3ref voices, --max-frames 1024; failed = capped, WER > 0.2 or a quiet run >= 3 s inside speech (Whisper large-v3)

per_frame_evidence.files: trace-20261121/: <take>.rows (prompt rows), <take>.frames (chosen main token and 9 codes per frame), <take>.per-frame.json (eos logit, rank, p and cumulative p, the top-8 candidates' logits, top candidate share, each nucleus keeps-eos, drawn main token). trace_eos.py derive makes the tables from a drama3-generate --logits-out trace; its analyze mode replays the pre-patch draws and matches 925/1024 frames on medium-05 s0 (the attractor frames wide margins; close speech races expose the replay as an approximation, e.g. 56/208 on medium-04 s0).
per_frame_evidence.tool: drama3-generate --logits-out FILE (patch 0008) with --rows-out and --out, the same seeds; the 16 MiB logits stay out of the repo, the derived tables and frames in trace-20261121/ are the committed record
per_frame_evidence.reading: On both medium-05 salts eos is rank 1 at p 2-22 % for ~680 frames from frame ~340 (logit ~15.4 against the pause candidate's ~19.5), and its cumulative probability sits above both top_p cutoffs (0.9 request, 0.95 RAS), so both truncated draws exclude the stop the model asks for every frame; the take holds quiet to the cap. On the other three traced takes eos is never excluded above 2 % before the stop.

reference_takes.protocol: failed: speaks only the first sentence through serve (WER 0.71); the bare-prompt trace stops
failed: a 3.13 s quiet run inside speech; eos is never excluded

cause.mechanism: After sentence 1 of medium-05, token 251273 (candidate 3175) carries ~96.6 % of the candidate mass with eos rank 1 at 2-22 %: nucleus truncation removes eos from both main-token draws, a stop the model asks for cannot be drawn, and the take runs to the frame cap.
cause.sentence2_unreachable: From frame ~250 the mass on resuming sentence 2 is under 0.5 % on these two seeds: the pause candidate takes the mass after sentence 1 and holds it. It is a per-seed degeneracy of the int3 build, not of the text: of 8 prompt-derived seeds of medium-05, 5 speak the whole text and stop on eos, 3 fall into the pause and end in silence.

fix: sample.metal draw_top keeps the eos candidate slot in both main-token draws (request top_p 0.9 and RAS top_p 0.95); kernels.zig forwards it and mirrors the keep rule in drawKeeps, forward.zig passes shards.eosCandidate(e.c, e.w.n_cand); code heads pass -1.

drama_host fills an unset silence guard with floor -40 dBFS / 3.5 s: the same collapse trails sub-floor quiet or murmur around a late eos. 3.5 s clears the longest quiet stretch inside any passing take (2.06 s built-in, 1.43 s reference), so a trip never cuts speech a take goes on to speak; --silence-seconds 0 still disables it.

serve redraws a Drama take the guard silenced, up to twice, with the next prompt-derived seed (salt + attempt); a take that stops on eos is never redrawn, so every take the guard does not trip is byte-identical. With redraws on, a streamed reply is held until its take is chosen, then sent as one chunk under that take's finish reason, so a silenced take is never streamed as the reply while a redraw remains. --silence-redraws 0 keeps the first take and live streaming.

verification.sampler_alone_stops_medium_05: With the patched sampler and no guard (drama3-generate, bare prompt, same seeds), medium-05 draws eos at frames 357 (s0) and 350 (s1) instead of capping: the eos exemption ends the runaway by itself. The committed <take>-after.frames hold those token streams; the three other traced takes keep every main token of their before trace and stop one frame earlier (m04s0, l01s1: the frame before the recorded eos) or 43 frames earlier (s01s0, an earlier eos the exemption lets through).
verification.serve_arms_note: Through serve the guard ends each collapsed first take - 3.5 s of sub-floor quiet after the speech - and the redraw speaks it again: medium-05 s0 on its second redraw, s1 and short-01 s0 on their first, each finishing on eos (finish=stop). The after arm is the round-1 serve arm with those three takes replaced by the redraw build's (the only takes the guard trips). Controls: short-02 s0 and short-01 s1 re-spoken on the redraw build are byte-identical to the round-1 arm, and medium-05 s0 and short-01 s0 re-spoken on the final build byte-identical to the scored redraws.

builtin.after_arm: not a full rerun: the round-1 serve arm with the 3 redrawn takes swapped in from the redraw build (see serve_arms_note for the 4 control takes)

issue_32: Hypothesis, not a traced fact: the full-model tagged-dialogue cap of issue #32 is consistent with this mechanism (a take runs to the cap while the model wants to stop), but no full-model trace was taken on this card. The Metal fix ports to the CUDA sampler (one kept-rule term, one slot argument, one default).
limits: Built-in failed takes go 4 -> 1 of 48: long-01 s1 stalls 3.13 s inside speech (a quiet-run failure under the 3.5 s guard, so no redraw; its audio is byte-identical before and after).
The two medium-05 redraws land on the same seed (s0's second, salt 0 + 2, and s1's first, salt 1 + 1) and speak the same bytes: redraw seeds overlap across salts by design of salt + attempt.
The redraw costs a collapsed take's time again (medium-05 s0: 11.75 s instead of ~4 s); with redraws on, a streamed reply's first audio waits for its whole take.
The CUDA nvfp4 sampler (engine/nvfp4/patches) shares the mechanism but is not ported here: no CUDA window on this Mac. The same changes apply.
